challenge-empty: There is nothing to export: no clips on tracks that are playing.
challenge-failed: The export did not finish. Try again.
challenge-long: This project is longer than an export can be.
challenge-too-large: This mix would be {{size}} MB, over the {{max}} MB limit for an entry. Download it instead.
challenge-too-large-after: The mix is over the 8 MB limit for an entry. Download it instead.
error-failed: The export did not finish. Try again, or export a shorter range.
import-bad: This is not a MIDI file the Studio can read. Nothing was changed.
import-empty: This file has no notes to import.
import-no-tempo: The file has no tempo; the project tempo stays as it is.
import-tempo: Set the project tempo to {{bpm}} BPM
import-too-large: This file is over 1 MB, which is more than the Studio will read.
import-unsupported: The Studio reads type 0 and type 1 MIDI files with tempo-based timing only.
midi-none: There are no MIDI or pattern notes to export. Audio tracks cannot be exported as MIDI.
refuse-empty: There is nothing to export: no clips on tracks that are playing.
refuse-no-loop: Set a loop region first, or export the whole song.
refuse-too-long: This is {{length}} long. An export can be at most {{max}} minutes; shorten the range.
refuse-too-long_one: This is {{length}} long. An export can be at most {{max}} minute; shorten the range.
refuse-too-long_other: This is {{length}} long. An export can be at most {{max}} minutes; shorten the range.
